llc.formation_notes: $130 online, $170 on paper; next-day expedite $100. Student entrepreneur waiver (Form 502SE) has no fee.

annual_report.name: Annual Report (Form 5)
annual_report.due: by the end of the calendar quarter in which the LLC's anniversary falls (Mar 31, Jun 30, Sep 30 or Dec 31), starting the year after formation

sources.title: Wisconsin DFI, Corporation Fees
sources.quote: Incorporation/Organization via Online Filing $100.00 $130.00 ... Annual Report via Online Filing $25.00

sources.title: DFI Annual Report Instructions
sources.quote: The report must be filed during the calendar year quarter in which the anniversary date of the incorporation/organization occurs.

entity_level_taxes.name: Economic development surcharge (Form 5S Schedule S)
entity_level_taxes.notes: Only if gross receipts from all activities are $4 million or more; greater of $25 or 0.2% of net income, max $9,800.

pte_elective_tax.rate_note: Entity-level tax election at 7.9% of Wisconsin net income for tax-option (S) corporations (Schedule 5S-ET, consent of >50% shareholders) and partnerships/LLCs taxed as partnerships (Schedule 3-ET); losses do not pass through.

sources.title: WI DOR, Pass-Through Entity-Level Tax: Tax-Option (S) Corporation
sources.quote: The net income reportable to Wisconsin is taxed at 7.9%

sources.title: 2025 Wisconsin Form 5S Instructions
sources.quote: The economic development surcharge applies to corporations having gross receipts from all activities of $4 million or more during the taxable year.

personal_exemption.notes: $700 per person (self, spouse, each dependent) deduction; +$250 each if 65+. Standard deduction shown is the maximum: it phases out (single: 12% of income over $20,120, zero at $136,453; MFJ: 19.778% over $29,040, zero at $159,690).

income_tax_2026.starting_point: federal AGI (Wisconsin income) with own sliding-scale standard deduction

sources.title: 2026 Form 1-ES Instructions (2026 tax rate and standard deduction schedules)
2026 Form 1-ES Instructions
sources.quote: Your exemptions are $700 for yourself, $700 for your spouse if filing a joint return, and $700 for each dependent.

estimated_tax.required_if: expect to owe at least $500 after withholding and credits
estimated_tax.notes: Safe harbor: 90% of 2026 tax or 100% of 2025 tax. Underpayment charged as interest (Schedule U).

unemployment_2026.notes: 3.05% for non-construction new employers (2.50% construction) in 2026; DWD 2027 schedule shows 3.25% when payroll is $500,000 or more.

notable: No LLC franchise or minimum tax; $25 online annual report (https://dfi.wi.gov/Pages/BusinessServices/BusinessEntities/Fees.aspx)

Entity-level (PTET) election at 7.9% for S corps and partnerships (https://www.revenue.wi.gov/Pages/FAQS/ise-scorp-determinc.aspx)
No local income taxes in Wisconsin
